- Risk: granting credits without a short follow-on commitment dilutes unit economics; we should attach a minimal conversion commitment or escalate a capped credit.

B) Approve a smaller credit ($3,000) + one-month extension; no additional discount, require a signed MRC within 60 days.
C) Decline credits, offer a 2-week extension and a 5% onboarding discount.

I recommend option A given the strategic upside; the attached usage shows they’re very close and this change de-risks the win. Approving A would show good will and increase likelihood of conversion.
